PREETI SHARMA | Product Owner | CSPO Vasundhara, Ghazia9999765608

bad | (347) 791-4252

| Preeti161sharma@gmail.com | Linkedin

SUMMARY Product Owner with 5+ years of experience delivering SaaS and digital products across cloud, banking, US healthcare, and CRM domains. Experienced in product discovery, roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, stakeholder management, and cross-functional execution.

CORE SKILLS Product Strategy • Product Discovery • Product Definition • Product Lifecycle Management • Roadmap Planning • Prioritization • Go-to-Market Strategy • User Research • Customer Journey Mapping • User Stories • Backlog Management • Agile/Scrum • Stakeholder Management • Cross-Functional Leadership • AI Product Management • Generative AI • AI/ML Products • Product Analytics • A/B Testing • Funnel Analysis • SQL • APIs • Data Analysis • Google Analytics • Dashboarding & BI • Tableau • Power BI • Healthcare Workflows • AWS • Azure • Jira • Confluence • GitHub

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Juniper Networks | Hewlett Packard Enterprise | Product Owner(Feb 2023- Present) Product: jCloud Licensing Platform – SaaS licensing platform enabling customers to activate, revoke, resolve, and manage software entitlements.

Owned end-to-end product lifecycle including discovery, roadmap planning, backlog

prioritization, development, launch, and post-release performance tracking • Led Agile product ownership activities including defining user stories, acceptance

criteria, and prioritization of features for licensing workflows

Partnered with Engineering, UX, and Support teams to redesign entitlement and activation flows, improving self-service adoption by 25% and reducing support dependency.

Leveraged Pendo and FullStory insights to identify friction points in customer journeys, reducing average license resolution time by 30% while improving feature engagement by 15%.

Owned and prioritized the product backlog, translating business and customer

requirements into epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.

Supported healthcare reporting initiatives involving data analysis, workflow requirements and stakeholder coordination, using Informatica and SQL/data analysis capabilities. • Worked with Engineering teams on Azure-based cloud product environments, translating business requirements into technical user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery priorities.

Partnered with technical teams to understand Azure cloud dependencies, APIs,

integrations, and application requirements while coordinating feature delivery across product and engineering teams.

University at Buffalo | Product Manager(Aug 2022- Jan 2023)

Product: AI Care – AI-powered elderly care solution supporting medication adherence and assisted care.

Defined the product vision and roadmap by conducting interviews with caregivers and potential users to identify unmet needs and prioritize features aligned with elderly care challenges.

Led product discovery efforts across medication adherence, fall detection, and assisted navigation capabilities, translating insights into MVP requirements and user stories. • Translated elderly-care and healthcare user needs into AI product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and implementation priorities.

Developed wireframes and prototypes to validate concepts with stakeholders, iterating on the experience to improve usability and accessibility for elderly populations.

Collaborated with multidisciplinary teams to define success criteria,

acceptance requirements, and implementation priorities aligned with product objectives.

Wolters Kluwer | Product Manager(Sep 2021- Jan 2022) • Product: Freelancing Marketplace Platform connecting freelancers and clients.

Owned product roadmap, MVP definition, and feature prioritization for freelancer-

client marketplace platform in an Agile environment.

Conducted funnel analysis to identify onboarding friction points and

implemented targeted improvements that increased free-trial activation rates by 12%.

Leveraged customer behavior analytics to identify churn drivers and

prioritize retention initiatives, resulting in a 4% reduction in monthly churn. • Collaborated with Design and Engineering teams to validate prototypes and

streamline execution, improving delivery efficiency by 15%.

Axtria | Product Owner(Mar 2020-Aug 2021) • Product: Life Sciences Education & Engagement Portal. • Led product enhancement roadmap using customer feedback, behavioral insights, and

stakeholder inputs in Agile framework.

Prioritized features and managed backlog to improve engagement and

adoption, increasing conversion by 25 basis points

Supported sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release coordination activities. • Streamlined prioritization processes and stakeholder alignment activities that reduced defect turnaround times by 20%.

Worked with Engineering teams on Azure-based cloud product environments,

translating business requirements into technical user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery priorities.

Supported Agile delivery of Azure-based product capabilities through requirement

clarification, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and cross-functional coordination with Engineering.

• Worked with Azure cloud environments including Azure App Services, Azure

Functions, Azure Storage, Azure APIs and Azure DevOps to support cloud-based product delivery and integrations.

TCS | Product Analyst / Business Data Analyst(Jun 2015-Feb 2020) • Product: Mobile Banking, Scheduling, and US Healthcare Reporting Platforms.

Supported Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments by defining requirements, user stories, and backlog items and Participating in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and reviews .

Worked on US Healthcare reporting platforms, gathering and translating business

requirements into reporting specifications, user stories and actionable backlog items. • Collaborated with Product Owners and cross-functional teams to define acceptance • Supported initiatives valued at $3–5M impacting 20,000+ users by prioritizing

self-service capabilities and improving customer journeys.

Redesigned scheduling workflows for a home tour platform, reducing

booking turnaround times by 45% and decreasing manual intervention by 25%.

Defined reporting requirements supporting healthcare initiatives using

Informatica, improving data retrieval efficiency by 60% and reducing turnaround times by 20%.

Dell International Services | Salesforce Developer(Mar 13-Jun 15) • Product: Salesforce CRM Platform supporting lead and case management. •

Implemented CRM enhancements and automated lead workflows in partnership with business stakeholders, improving workflow efficiency by 15% and reducing manual effort by 20%.

Optimized case management processes and reporting capabilities to

improve operational visibility, reducing average case handling times by 15%.
